title: Daily Workout · October 21
note: 55-minute workout. Begin with your regular four stretches, including Plow Pose (Halasana), with no extra reset exercise. Flat treadmill walking. Use New Balance shoes if comfortable; if right forefoot tingling develops, stop and allow it to resolve before changing to HOKAs. Keep hip hinges and core work controlled and stop if back or groin discomfort occurs.

items.name: Lying quad stretch
items.instructions: Lie on your side and gently draw your top heel toward your glutes. Switch sides halfway.

items.name: Butterfly stretch
items.instructions: Sit with the soles of your feet together and allow knees to fall outward comfortably; do not force them down.

items.name: Seated spinal twist
items.instructions: Sit tall and rotate gently within your comfortable range, without forcing the twist.

items.name: Plow Pose (Halasana)
items.detail: 20–30 seconds with gentle entry and exit · 1 minute
items.instructions: Stay within your established comfortable range. Avoid forcing feet to the floor or putting pressure on your neck.

items.name: Easy warm-up
items.instructions: Begin at an easy comfortable pace.

items.name: Steady walk
items.instructions: Walk at a conversational pace. Stop if forefoot tingling develops.

items.name: Brisk walk
items.instructions: Walk briskly without jogging; adjust speed for comfort.

items.name: Cool-down
items.instructions: Gradually slow to an easy walk.

items.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
items.instructions: Hinge at your hips with soft knees and a neutral back. Keep weights close to legs and use a controlled range.

items.name: Dumbbell floor press
items.instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent. Lower elbows gently toward the floor and press weights upward without holding your breath.

items.name: Supported one-arm dumbbell row
items.instructions: Support one hand on a stable surface, maintain a neutral back, and row the dumbbell toward your hip.

items.name: Forearm plank
items.instructions: Keep body aligned, breathe steadily, and rest between sets. Stop for groin or back discomfort.

items.name: Dead bugs
items.instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms up. Extend opposite arm and leg only as far as you can without arching your back or causing discomfort.

items.name: Cloud hands
items.instructions: Side-step slowly as hands sweep across the body in a relaxed flowing rhythm.

items.name: Parting the horse's mane
items.instructions: Coordinate gentle steps with a smooth separating motion of the arms.

items.name: Brush knee and push
items.instructions: Sweep one hand past the knee as the other pushes gently forward, changing sides slowly.
